fusions.name: Wrung Poultice
fusions.desc: Wrings a venom-soaked rag out in a cone up to 5 tiles ahead, dealing 10 damage and leaving everything caught [Poisoned] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to enemies within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Drawn Sting
fusions.desc: Flings a wet poultice pad that deals 8 damage to the first enemy it meets and draws one of your afflictions out of it, healing you for 20% of the damage dealt. It needs an affliction of yours on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Fresh Dressings
fusions.desc: Changes the dressings on you and every ally, removing up to 2 poison conditions from each.

fusions.name: Soaked Through
fusions.desc: Each affliction laid on you has a 20% chance to be sent back to whoever laid it. Your poison resistance rises by 10%.
